articles.title: Hamilton man charged with murder in stabbing of 21-year-old
articles.summary: Hamilton police say Zenin Roussel was found by a taxi driver with stab wounds in the area of Main Street West and Frid Street on Sunday.

articles.summary: The Niagara Regional Police Service (NRPS) Homicide Unit is appealing for public assistance after investigators identified human remains discovered during a 2023 demolition in Niagara Falls, Ont., as belonging to a woman who vanished more than two decades ago. articles.summary: Admitting on Tuesday that he “got this one wrong” when he was one of 21 city councillors who voted in favour of adding bike lanes along a stretch of Bloor Street West in Etobicoke, mayoral candidate Brad Bradford is now vowing to remove them if he’s voted in as mayor when Torontonians head to the […]

articles.title: Brampton landlord sentenced after 2023 fire that killed pregnant mother and child
articles.summary: Brampton officials are issuing a forceful reminder to landlords about their legal responsibilities after a court ruling tied to a 2023 fatal house fire that killed a pregnant woman and her three‑year‑old daughter and left another family member with lifelong injuries. articles.title: Bradford vows Bloor Street W. bike lanes are 'coming out' if he's mayor
articles.summary: Toronto mayoral candidate Brad Bradford is promising the removal of bike lanes on a west-end street should he win the city’s top job.

articles.title: Missing 63-year-old woman found: Toronto police
articles.summary: Police say they have located a 63-year-old woman who had been missing since Saturday, when she was last seen in North York.

articles.title: 'Everyone is chipping in to make this happen': Toronto charity building micro-shelter village in Scarborough
articles.summary: Tiny Tiny Homes, a Toronto charity that builds mobile and emergency shelters to those experiencing homelessness, is building a micro-shelter village in Scarborough that will provide transitional housing to 10 people by the end of this year.

articles.title: Environment Canada's updated tornado, severe thunderstorm warning system aims to target specific areas
articles.summary: Environment and Climate Change Canada has updated its warning system for tornadoes and severe thunderstorms to allow for more precise warnings about severe weather.
